name: notedeck
title: NoteDeck
description: Post, search and jump around NoteDeck (Misskey client, Misskey Pro) from Raycast through its local HTTP API and notedeck:// links.
author: hitalin

commands.name: post
commands.title: Post Note
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Write a note and post it through NoteDeck (confirmed in the NoteDeck window), or hand it to NoteDeck's post form.

commands.name: compose
commands.title: Open Post Form
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Open NoteDeck's post form, optionally with text already filled in.

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search My Notes
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Search your own notes and memos in NoteDeck's local archive. Empty query shows recent ones.

commands.name: columns
commands.title: Jump to Column
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Focus a deck column in NoteDeck.

commands.name: profile
commands.title: Switch Deck Profile
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Switch NoteDeck's deck profile by name.

commands.name: ask-ai
commands.title: Ask AI
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Open NoteDeck's AI column with a prompt filled in.

commands.name: memo
commands.title: New Memo
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Create a local memo in NoteDeck.

commands.name: run
commands.title: Run Capability
commands.subtitle: NoteDeck
commands.description: Browse every NoteDeck capability and run one with parameters.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: NoteDeck API URL
preferences.description: Base URL of the built-in HTTP API. Leave the default unless you changed the port.

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Persistent API token issued in NoteDeck: Settings → Permissions → API tokens.
